svg.text: The reference's look: flat colour, a big round head on a small body, thin dark outlines. His own: a dark mop of hair with a cowlick and a slate-blue roll-neck.
dot eyes with one highlight; the brows do the acting; no nose, a short mouth
• flat fills, one soft shade, thin dark outlines: the reference's grammar
• his marks: hair + cowlick, roll-neck, slate blue (theirs: bald, hoodie, grey)
• he is the only cool colour on screen; amber belongs to the Pull
• three heads tall, so the face reads on a phone
